imageconvert.t53: JPEG has no alpha channel. Transparent areas are filled with the background colour above.
imageconvert.t54: WebP can keep transparency. Turn on “fill transparency with the background colour” and you get an opaque WebP.
imageconvert.t55: PNG is lossless. Turn on “fill transparency with the background colour” and you get a PNG with the alpha removed.
